targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  l.atm_id as "ATM ID",
  l.branch as "Branch",
  l.district as "District",
  l.city as "City",
  l.vendor as "Vendor",
  l.terminal_id as "Terminal ID",
  COALESCE(t.total, 0) as "Txns (1h)",
  COALESCE(t.approved, 0) as "Approved",
  COALESCE(t.declined, 0) as "Declined",
  COALESCE(t.success_rate, 0)
    as "Success %",
  COALESCE(t.cash_dispensed, 0)
    as "Cash (ETB)",
  CASE
    WHEN t.atm_id IS NULL THEN 'No Data'
    WHEN t.success_rate >= 95 THEN 'Healthy'
    WHEN t.success_rate >= 80 THEN 'Degraded'
    ELSE 'Critical'
  END as "Health"
FROM atm_locations l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    atm_id,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status='APPROVED'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status='DECLINED'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as declined,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(
      CASE WHEN status='APPROVED'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) / COUNT(*), 1) as success_rate,
    COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE WHEN status='APPROVED'
      AND txn_type='WITHDRAWAL'
      THEN amount ELSE 0 END
    ), 0) as cash_dispensed
  FROM atm_transactions
  WHERE recorded_at >=
    NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  GROUP BY atm_id
) t ON l.atm_id = t.atm_id
WHERE (
  '${district:raw}' = 'All'
  OR l.district = ANY(
    STRING_TO_ARRAY(
      '${district:raw}', ','
    )
  )
)
ORDER BY l.atm_id

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) as total_dispensed
FROM atm_transactions
WHERE
  status = 'APPROVED'
  AND txn_type = 'WITHDRAWAL'
  AND recorded_at >= CURRENT_DATE

SELECT
  recorded_at as "Time",
  atm_id as "ATM",
  branch as "Branch",
  txn_type as "Type",
  card_masked as "Card",
  amount as "Amount (ETB)",
  status as "Status"
FROM atm_transactions
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  atm_id,
  COUNT(*) as total_transactions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as declined,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as errors
FROM atm_transactions
WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY atm_id
ORDER BY atm_id

SELECT
    detected_at   AS "Time",
    atm_id        AS "ATM",
    branch        AS "Branch",
    anomaly_type  AS "Type",
    severity      AS "Severity",
    card_masked   AS "Card",
    detail        AS "Detail",
    CASE WHEN acknowledged THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Acked"
FROM atm_anomalies
WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY detected_at DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Unacknowledged Anomalies"
FROM atm_anomalies
WHERE acknowledged = FALSE
AND detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 minutes'

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', detected_at) AS time,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anomaly_type='VELOCITY')      AS "Velocity Abuse",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anomaly_type='FAILURE_SPIKE') AS "Failure Spike",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anomaly_type='LARGE_TXN')     AS "Large Withdrawal",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anomaly_type='RAPID_SEQ')     AS "Rapid Sequential",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE anomaly_type='OFFHOURS_SPIKE')AS "Off-Hours Spike"
FROM atm_anomalies
WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', detected_at)
ORDER BY time

SELECT
    anomaly_type  AS "Type",
    COUNT(*)      AS "Count",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='HIGH')   AS "High",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='MEDIUM') AS "Medium"
FROM atm_anomalies
WHERE detected_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY anomaly_type
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

SELECT
    recorded_at          AS "time",
    latency_ms           AS "Latency (ms)",
    packet_loss          AS "Packet Loss (%)",
    CASE status
        WHEN 'DEGRADED' THEN 50
        WHEN 'DOWN' THEN 100
        ELSE 0
    END AS "Degradation Level"
FROM atm_network_metrics
WHERE atm_id = '$atm_id'
AND recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours'
ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT
    correlated_at                AS "Detected At",
    atm_id                       AS "ATM",
    branch                       AS "Branch",
    event_type                   AS "Event",
    ROUND(metric_value::numeric,0) AS "Latency (ms)",
    txns_in_window               AS "Txns During Event",
    txns_failed                  AS "Failed",
    ROUND(failure_rate::numeric,1)     AS "Fail Rate %",
    ROUND(baseline_fail_rate::numeric,1) AS "Baseline %",
    ROUND(uplift::numeric,1)           AS "Network Impact (+pp)",
    cards_affected               AS "Cards Affected"
FROM atm_network_correlation
WHERE correlated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
ORDER BY uplift DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) as success_rate
FROM atm_transactions
WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('hour', recorded_at) as time,
  atm_id,
  COUNT(*) as transactions
FROM atm_transactions
WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', recorded_at), atm_id
ORDER BY time
